notes: The programme's own page (https://www.hs-fulda.de/ibm) was cut off in the supplied text; details on the application channel for international applicants could not be confirmed. The DAAD page says 'Submit application via Please check this website.' The tuition fact is evidenced by 'Tuition fees per semester None' and 'studiengebührenfreie Rahmenbedingungen', but it is a general statement for the university and the programme; the statutory semester contribution (e.g. 404.80 EUR for winter semester 26/27) is separate and not included. Intake dates are for foreign applicants from all countries and refer to the winter semester 2026 and summer semester 2026 respectively; no year is stated in the quote, so 2026 is inferred from the surrounding text 'International Programmes 2026/2027'. No explicit document list for international applicants was found on the supplied pages.
